name: SVC_COMPETENCIES_
description:
A Competency is a reference to an LOV that must exist in Fusion (eg. Product, Category, Language, Region, Severity, so on).  Some Competencies can have one LOV, some can have a parent-child combination of 2 LOVs.
That means some competencies are codependent and some can be independent.

columns.name: COMPETENCY_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: COMPETENCY_NAME
columns.description: Name of the competency, e.g., Product, Category, Language, Region, and Severity.

columns.name: COMPETENCY_NUMBER
columns.description: Public unique identifier for Competency.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Specifies the original system reference if the record was imported.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this competency is logically deleted (Y or N).

columns.name: PARENT_COMPETENCY_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the codependent competency.

columns.name: CAN_HAVE_PROFICIENCY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the competency can have a proficiency (Y or N).

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: Specifies the order in which the competencies should be relaxed.

columns.name: CAN_BE_RELAXED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the competency can be relaxed (Y or N).

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Path to the entity object or the name of the standard lookup.

columns.name: DATA_ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: Indicates which attribute from the source contains the competency value that we will store in the skill.

columns.name: DATA_DISPLAY_ATTRIBUTES
columns.description: Indicates which attributes from the source contains the competency details that we will display to the customer.

columns.name: PARENT_FILTER
columns.description: The name of the filter to be used to display only some competencies values based on the value selected in the parent competency.

columns.name: WORK_OBJECT_ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: Identifier of the work object field name.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Stores the Original Impersonator User.
